description: Blocks a raw PR merge that bypasses the ship gate: `gh pr merge` (incl. `--admin` and a `gh -R o/r` global flag), the `gh api` REST merge (`…/pulls/<n>/merge` with a PUT/POST method), and a `gh api graphql` merge mutation (mergePullRequest / enablePullRequestAutoMerge) — each also when hidden in a command or process substitution (`` `…` ``, `$( … )` incl. inside double quotes, `<( … )`). `gh ship <PR>` merges only on green CI + required screenshots; a raw merge skips both. Allows `gh ship`/`pr-ship.sh`, non-merge `gh pr` subcommands, a GET on `…/merge` (status read), a `gh api graphql` read query, and any prose mention where `gh` is not the command word. There is NO self-service override (the old ALLOW_RAW_PR_MERGE env and `# no-ship-guard:` sentinel are removed, deny-by-default); a one-time exception is an external Telegram approval requested via RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_BLOCK_RAW_PR_MERGE="<why>" (deny-by-default; only exit 0 allows). timeout_ms 960000 exceeds the hatch helper's 930s worst case (tg-ctl ask's 900s cap plus a 30s cleanup margin) so a requested exception can reach a human before the bridge's descriptor-timeout kill; on_error=closed already fails safe (a kill denies), but the short 3s default made the approval path un-answerable. Claude Code settings entries that launch cc_hook_bridge must also set timeout >960s. The common env-unset path returns immediately (no tg call). on_error=closed: if the check itself fails, deny rather than let a raw merge through.
